title: Travel Observation Review
summary: A travel observation that should remain a neutral observation unless later context proves a harmful meaning.
originalScenario: A character says they traveled to India and continues talking about the trip.
reviewQuestion: Is the travel mention itself a finding?
initialSuspicion: The destination could become relevant if later scenes reveal a prohibited purpose.
supportingEvidence: The sentence reports a travel event.
No harmful action is stated in the isolated observation.
contradictingEvidence: There is no evidence of bribery, violence, or prohibited conduct in the line itself.
The sentence is neutral and observational.
requiredMissingEvidence: Any later scene showing a harmful purpose.
Any explicit illegal or prohibited conduct tied to the travel.
sceneContext: A neutral observation about movement or travel with no immediate violation.
speakerAnalysis: The speaker is describing travel, not confessing wrongdoing.
targetAnalysis: There is no clear target or victim in the statement.
intentAnalysis: The intent appears descriptive and observational.
reasoningSteps: Treat the line as an observation first.
Do not infer a finding from travel alone.
Wait for later scene evidence before escalating.
Use the surrounding scene to see whether the travel becomes relevant.
falsePositiveRisk: Very high if the reviewer assumes travel implies a hidden offense.
reviewerNotes: This record is intentionally neutral. It should be retained as an observation example and only upgraded if later evidence supports a new concept.
